clusters.name: Mortgage and real estate brokerage
clusters.description: Help homebuyers arrange mortgages and buy or sell property, earning loan origination income and transaction commissions.

clusters.name: Residential real estate brokerage
clusters.description: Represent local home buyers and sellers, earning commissions from property transactions.

clusters.name: Unspecified real estate activity
clusters.description: Hold a real estate license and acquire property, with the service, customer and revenue model unspecified.

clusters.name: Residential rental property ownership
clusters.description: Own houses or apartment buildings, rent units to residents, and earn recurring rent with possible appreciation or refinancing proceeds.

clusters.name: Mixed-use commercial property ownership
clusters.description: Own and lease retail, commercial or mixed-use property to business and residential tenants, earning rental income and building occupancy.

clusters.name: Real estate contract wholesaling
clusters.description: Secure below-market property deals and assign or resell them to investors and builders for a fee or spread.

clusters.name: Niche property listings marketplace
clusters.description: List specialized commercial property types for buyers and sellers, with the marketplace’s monetization model unspecified.

clusters.name: Residential subdivision development
clusters.description: Develop residential subdivisions and arrange homes and related services for buyers, earning from property development or sales.

clusters.name: Property management services
clusters.description: Manage properties and coordinate services for property owners and developers, earning management fees.

clusters.name: General real estate investment
clusters.description: Buy or hold real estate as an investment, with property type, customers and returns unspecified.

clusters.name: RV park operation
clusters.description: Own or operate RV parks and rent sites to travelers for guest fees.

clusters.name: House flipping
clusters.description: Buy houses, sometimes using targeted leads or lower-cost materials, improve them and resell for a profit.

clusters.name: Shed-to-tiny-home rentals or resale
clusters.description: Finish sheds as small homes and rent or resell them to people seeking lower-cost accommodation.

clusters.name: Rural land subdivision and resale
clusters.description: Buy rural land, divide it into smaller lots and sell the lots to land buyers for a margin.

clusters.name: Mobile home and land resale
clusters.description: Pair a used mobile home with land and sell the ready-to-live property to affordable-home buyers for a margin.

clusters.name: Real estate staging
clusters.description: Provide property staging services, with the customer and revenue model unspecified.

clusters.name: Storage-yard land investment
clusters.description: Hold premium land and operate storage yards on it, earning yard rent and potential appreciation.

clusters.name: Almond farming and supply-chain sales
clusters.description: Grow almonds and sell processed, packaged or branded products to food buyers.

clusters.name: Land-owning cattle operation
clusters.description: Own land and raise cattle, using cattle sales to cover operating costs while holding the land for long-term value.

clusters.name: Ranch land investment
clusters.description: Hold a ranch for family use, potential appreciation and possible rental or agricultural income.

clusters.name: Mobile home park ownership
clusters.description: Own mobile home parks and collect lot rent from residents.

clusters.name: Land speculation near new developments
clusters.description: Buy land near announced anchor developments and resell it as the area grows, earning from appreciation.

clusters.name: Farm-based land financing strategy
clusters.description: Use farm sales and eligibility for agricultural financing to acquire land and buildings for a growing farm, rentals or agritourism operation.

clusters.name: Self-storage facility ownership and development
clusters.description: Build or acquire self-storage facilities and rent units to households and businesses for recurring fees.

clusters.name: Realtor service referrals
clusters.description: Refer real estate clients to partner service providers and earn a commission on completed jobs.

clusters.name: Vacation rental ownership
clusters.description: Own distinctive short-term rentals and earn nightly booking income from travelers, with possible proceeds from a later sale.

clusters.name: RV and mobile home park acquisitions
clusters.description: Acquire RV and mobile home parks and earn operating income from lot and site rents.

clusters.name: Campground investment fund
clusters.description: Pool limited-partner capital to acquire campgrounds, with the fund’s fee and return model unspecified.

clusters.name: Scraped FSBO cash-offer property deals
clusters.description: Scrape for-sale-by-owner listings and send low cash offers to sellers, aiming to earn a resale or wholesale spread.

clusters.name: Social-media-funded short-term rental build
clusters.description: Document a short-term rental project online to attract investors and guests, earning from bookings and raised capital.

clusters.name: Commercial leasing brokerage
clusters.description: Connect commercial property owners and expanding businesses with tenants or space, earning commissions on leases.

clusters.name: Real estate investing with unspecified details
clusters.description: Invest in real estate through a pooled fund or other arrangement, with the specific offer and revenue model unspecified.

clusters.name: Cell-site ground leases
clusters.description: Lease property to mobile carriers for cell sites and collect recurring ground rent.

clusters.name: Utility and pipeline easements
clusters.description: Grant utilities or pipeline operators easement rights across land in exchange for a payment.

clusters.name: Mineral-rights ownership checks
clusters.description: Check whether mineral rights remain attached to a property deed, with the service’s monetization model unspecified.
